skill_name: Summarize the text “The Cat in the Hat” in less than 100 words
workflow: The Cat in the Hat is a beloved classic written by Dr. Seuss. It tells the story of two children whose rainy day is interrupted by a mischievous cat in a red and white-striped hat. This tall, playful cat causes quite the stir as he helps the two children explore their creativity, enjoy themselves, and tidy up their home by the end of the day. It's a merry tale that doesn't fail to delight!
